heard.quote: Can it diagnose or recommend a treatment?
heard.answer: No, by design. It quotes the published price, points to the treatment on your menu for the concern the patient named, and says the doctor decides at the consultation. It will not assess a photo, promise a result or predict how many sessions. That is the line we built to, and it is the reason a doctor-led clinic can run it at all.

heard.quote: We are on respond.io today. Can we keep it?
heard.answer: One WhatsApp number can only sit on one API connection. So the patient-facing number moves to the agent, respond.io keeps your other channels, or a second number runs the agent. Your contacts come over as an export that we load for the first reactivation campaign. There is no live sync between the two systems.

heard.quote: I want to overbook trials by two or three because people do not show up.
heard.answer: The agent books into the slots your calendar has open. Overbooking is not a feature. If you want it, we add two or three standby calendars per centre so bookings can go over capacity, and your desk manages the overlap on the day. We say that before you sign, not after.

heard.quote: Can it reschedule, send reminders and show me every follow-up it sent?
heard.answer: It books. A cancellation or a change goes to your desk, not the agent. Appointment reminders are not built in today, and the report shows campaign sent and replied counts plus a stats bar, not a per-message log of every follow-up. If those three are the reason you are buying, wait.

heard.quote: Our weekday chairs are under 40% full and all our marketing is Instagram.
heard.answer: Then an agent is the wrong first purchase. It only answers people who already message you. The salon that told us this got a website and search work from us instead, because its first problem was being found. Come back when WhatsApp fills up faster than your desk can clear it.

faq: Can an AI agent answer WhatsApp enquiries for an aesthetic clinic in Singapore without breaking MOH rules?

Yes, if it stays off medical ground. 41 Closer quotes the published price before GST, explains what the consultation involves and books it. It never diagnoses and never promises a result. It will not read a photo or offer a discount. Anything medical goes to the doctor.
What does it say when a patient asks how much pico laser is at 9pm?

It replies in seconds with your from-price for that treatment, before GST, and the consultation fee. It says the doctor confirms the number of sessions at the consultation. Then it offers the next open slot or your booking link. In the demo we built for one clinic the example was from S$108 a session, that clinic's own published price.
Does it book the consultation or just send a link?

On Starter it sends your booking link. On Pro it reads your calendar, offers real times, holds the slot and collects the consultation fee in the chat. The clinic demo asked for S$55 to secure the slot, which was that clinic's published fee.
What happens when someone messages about pain or a lump after a treatment?
The agent treats it as urgent. It gives the clinic phone and alerts your team in the same turn, and your phone buzzes. You take over the chat in the inbox. It never tries to advise on the complaint.

In the demo we built for one clinic a patient asked for a price in Chinese and got the answer in Chinese. English and the mixed English Singapore customers type are standard. Ask us before you count on any other language.
How much does a WhatsApp AI agent cost for a clinic or salon?

Starter is S$690 a month and Pro is S$1,490 a month. The build is included and there is no setup fee. Connecting a system we have connected before is a one-time S$2,400. One month to start, charged from the day it goes live, then month to month with 30 days notice and no contract. No GST is charged, and eligible Singapore SMEs can apply the EDGE grant, which replaced the EDG on 30 September 2026, to part of the cost, up to 70% of qualifying costs.
We have two centres. Does it handle both?

Yes, with one choice to make first. Each centre runs as its own calendar inside one agent, or each centre gets its own workspace and number. We walk through both with you before the build. There is no separate outlet setting beyond those two.

48 hours from your treatment list with published prices. We build the agent, you message it yourself, then one free hour where we show you the platform and connect payments and your WhatsApp. Billing starts the day it goes live.
